description: Windows 7 twin of `../capabilities/default.json`, read INSTEAD of it by the Win7 build (build.rs points tauri-build at this directory). Identical except that `notification:default` is absent — the notification plugin is not compiled into the Win7 build (it binds WinRT, which Windows 7 lacks), and Tauri's ACL rejects a capability naming a permission from a plugin that isn't registered. Keep the two directories in step: any permission added to `../capabilities/default.json` belongs here too, unless it comes from a plugin the Win7 build leaves out.
